chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'When one of you copulates, let him not come to her as the bird comes [quickly]. Let him endure and let him linger.' Some of them said, 'And let him linger.'
ai.seo_question: What is the prophetic etiquette regarding sexual intimacy and timing?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* emphasizes the Prophetic etiquette of marital intimacy, contrasting hasty, mechanical acts with a deliberate, lingering approach that fosters emotional and physical connection. The variant reading 'liyatabath' (to delay/tarry) underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on patience and presence during conjugal relations as a means of enhancing mutual satisfaction and spiritual bond.
